title: Sunbeam Alpine
subtitle: Dr No
description: The Alpine was the first James Bond car and had no alterations by Q's lab.

title: Bentley Mark IV
subtitle: From Russia with Love
description: James Bond does not actually drive the car but he does use the car telephone, which for 1963 is quite unusual.

title: Aston Martin DB5
subtitle: Goldfinger
description: Two DB5s were built for the film; the licence plate was BMT 216A.

title: Lincoln Continental Convertible
subtitle: Thunderball
description: Ford supplied a Lincoln Continental for the car compactor scene in exchange for featuring their new model Ford Mustang.

title: Toyota GT 2000
subtitle: You Only Live Twice
description: Just two convertibles were custom built for the film.

title: Aston Martin DBS
subtitle: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
description: The DBS goes 0 to 60 mph in less than six seconds.

title: Ford Galaxie Sedan 500
subtitle: Diamonds are Forever
description: Bond is sitting in a copper-plated Sedan when he meets with Felix.

title: Chevrolet Impala Convertible
subtitle: Live and Let Die
description: Bond arrives on Dr. Kananga's island with Rosie Carver in this car.

title: AMC Hornet X
subtitle: The Man with the Golden Gun
description: This is the vehicle that performs the infamous bridge jump.

title: Lotus Esprit S1
subtitle: The Spy Who Loved Me
description: Possesses a full underwater kit that transforms the car into a submarine in the event of submersion.

title: MP Lafer
subtitle: Moonraker
description: Glamorous field agent Manuela trails Bond in this car, darting in and out of traffic.

title: Citroen 2CV
subtitle: For Your Eyes Only
description: Bond's Lotus Esprit Turbo self destructs so he has to resort to Melina Havelock's 2CV to make their escape.

title: Range Rover Classic Convertible
subtitle: Octopussy
description: Bond makes his getaway piloting a Bede BD-5 Acrostar Microjet which he has in a trailer on the back.

title: Renault 11
subtitle: A View to Kill
description: After an exciting high-speed chase, the Renault 11 is violently chopped in half by another car.

title: Aston Martin V8 Vantage Volante
subtitle: The Living Daylights
description: Equipped with out-riggers for "skiing" off road in snowy conditions.

title: Lincoln Mark VII LSC
subtitle: Licence to Kill
description: The Lincoln Mark VII LSC could do 0 - 60mph in 8.3 seconds.

title: BMW Z3
subtitle: GoldenEye
description: Bond only manages a short ride before Jack Wade (US contact) takes possession of the vehicle.

title: BMW 750iL
subtitle: Tomorrow Never Dies
description: Conveniently controlled by a remote control in 007's mobile phone.

title: BMW Z8
subtitle: The World Is Not Enough
description: Contained rocket-firing system hidden in side vents - car was destroyed after being cut in two.

title: Ford Fairlane
subtitle: Die Another Day
description: The Ford Fairlane is given to Bond by Raoul (Emilio Echevarria) when he asks for "a fast car".

title: Aston Martin DBS V12
subtitle: Casino Royale
description: Given to 007 by M on his first assignment - has a medical station, containing a defibrillator and poison analysis kit.

title: Aston Martin DBS
subtitle: Quantum of Solace
description: Same model as previous film but is wrecked during the opening pursuit scene after Bond abducts Mr. White.

title: Aston Martin DB5
subtitle: Skyfall
description: This will be the sixth time the Aston Martin DB5 has featured in a Bond movie.

title: Land Rover Defender
subtitle: Skyfall
description: The Defender also makes a brief appearance in The Living Daylights, where it is driven off a cliff.

title: Aston Martin DB10
subtitle: Spectre
description: A bespoke design for Spectre, production of this Aston Martin DB10 will be limited to 10 cars.

title: Aston Martin Valhalla
subtitle: No Time To Die
description: 007's 25th outing needed to feature something extra special, and the Aston Martin Valhalla is certainly that.
